messages:
Sam: Morning — nightly perf CI flagged a ~20% p50 regression on the small-batch throughput job (model-run-smallbatch/v2). Alert started ~00:15 UTC. Anyone able to take a quick look?
infra-bot: nightly-ci: job model-run-smallbatch failed 3 runs in a row. Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/job/12345 :warning:
Maria: on it, grabbing logs + flamegraphs now.
Jordan: starting a quick bisect across the last infra image builds, tagging @Maria.
Sam: thanks. Maria, if you see kernel scheduling / hrtime spikes paste the top traces — might be the kernel flag toggle from yesterday.
Maria: logs show an uptick in hrtimer wakeups and high `cpu_idle` wait. Flamegraph shows more time in timer wheel and memcpy stalls. Stack snippet:```text
#0 0x7f8a1c2f hrtimer_run
#1 0x7f8a1c4b run_timers
#2 0x7f8a2aa0 schedule
```
Ashley: I saw something similar on Friday's small-batch run but flagged as noisy. Could the NVLINK driver bump in the infra image be related?
Jordan: bisect in progress: testing images from 2026-03-16T23:30 -> 2026-03-17T00:30 (5 incremental commits). I'll report the culprit if it reproduces locally.
Sam: if bisect points to the driver change let's spin a canary with the older driver/stable kernel module and run the perf job against it. @infra please standby.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pool launched with older nvlink driver (kv1). 4 instances online, health checks green. Monitoring perf metrics.
Maria: uploaded failing run flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/fg/abcd. Hot path shows memcpy gpu->cpu + long waits in submit queue (sustained stalls).
Jordan: bisect result: commit 3/5 is the regression; touches scheduler.c and the driver binding path. Reproduces on local repro with same workload.
Ashley: queued a canary perf run against the fallback pool (1000 iters, small-batch config). Will post results in ~15m.
Sam: thanks. If canary looks good we'll promote fallback and open a rollback PR for that commit. Also let's add an emergency CI perf test to catch this pattern earlier.
Maria: also proposing we run a lightweight small-batch perf every 2h — nightly cadence is too coarse to catch regressions quickly.
Jordan: filed issue #2456 and added bisect notes + initial repro steps. PR to revert commit: https://git.redwood/pr/789 :link:
Sam: :thumbsup: keep updates here. If canary passes and metrics look stable, we'll promote and merge the rollback. If it fails, we'll escalate to infra on-call for deeper driver/kernel tracing.
